title: Akampana enters the battle-field
introduction: Akampana enters the battle-field and assails the monkeys with his bow and arrows. Then, Hanuman comes to the rescue of the monkeys. A great fight ensued between Akampana and Hanuman. Hanuman strikes the head of Akampana with a huge tree and Akampana dies. All the demons take to their heels and return to Lanka.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे षट्पञ्चाशः सर्गः
Thus completes 56th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तद् दृष्ट्वा सुमहत् कर्म कृतम् वानर सत्तमैः |
क्रोधम् आहारयाम् आस युधि तीव्रम् अकम्पनः
verses.iast:
tad dṛṣṭvā sumahat karma kṛtam vānara sattamaiḥ |
krodham āhārayām āsa yudhi tīvram akampanaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that very great exploit executed by the chiefs of monkeys in the battle, Akampana was seized with a fierce anger.

verses.devanagari:
क्रोध मूर्चित रूपस् तु ध्नुवन् परम कार्मुकम् |
दृष्ट्वा तु कर्म शत्रूणाम् सारथिम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
krodha mūrcita rūpas tu dhnuvan parama kārmukam |
dṛṣṭvā tu karma śatrūṇām sārathim vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Witnessing that work of the enemies, his features were distorted by anger and brandishing his powerful bow, Akampana addressed his charioteer in these words.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र एव तावत् त्वरितम् रथम् प्रापय सारथे |
एते अत्र बहवो घ्नन्ति सुबहून् राक्षसान् रणे
verses.iast:
tatra eva tāvat tvaritam ratham prāpaya sārathe |
ete atra bahavo ghnanti subahūn rākṣasān raṇe
verses.translation: "Drive the chariot quickly to that place, for, those monkeys are killing innumerable demons on the battle field."

verses.devanagari:
एते अत्र बलवन्तो हि भीम कायाश् च वानराः |
द्रुम शैल प्रहरणास् तिष्ठन्ति प्रमुखे मम
verses.iast:
ete atra balavanto hi bhīma kāyāś ca vānarāḥ |
druma śaila praharaṇās tiṣṭhanti pramukhe mama
verses.translation: "Those arrogant monkeys of terrific ferocity, armed with trees and rocks, dare to affront me here."

glosses.meaning: with trees and rocks as their weapons

verses.devanagari:
एतान् निहन्तुम् इच्चामि समर श्लाघिनो ह्य् अहम् |
एतैः प्रमथितम् सर्वम् दृश्यते राक्षसम् बलम्
verses.iast:
etān nihantum iccāmi samara ślāghino hy aham |
etaiḥ pramathitam sarvam dṛśyate rākṣasam balam
verses.translation: "I wish to kill those andicious monkeys, who are seen herassing all the army of demons."

glosses.meaning: who are praising themselves in battle

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रजवित अश्वेन रथेन रथिनाम् वरः |
हरीन् अभ्यहनत् क्रोधात् शर जालैर् अकम्पनः
verses.iast:
tataḥ prajavita aśvena rathena rathinām varaḥ |
harīn abhyahanat krodhāt śara jālair akampanaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, in his chariot, drawn by fast-moving horses, Akampana the most skillful of chariot-warriors, with a hail of darts, assailed the monkeys from a distance.

verses.devanagari:
न स्थातुम् वानराह् शेकुह् किम् पुनर् योद्धुम् आहवे |
अकम्पन शरैर् भग्नाह् सर्व;एव प्रदुद्रुवुः
verses.iast:
na sthātum vānarāh śekuh kim punar yoddhum āhave |
akampana śarair bhagnāh sarva;eva pradudruvuḥ
verses.translation: The monkeys were no longer able to maintain their formation, much less fight in the battle. all of them were crushed under the shifts of Akampana and took to their heels.

verses.devanagari:
तान् मृत्यु वशम् आपन्नान् अकम्पन वशम् गतान् |
समीक्ष्य हनुमान् ज्नातीन् उपतस्थे महा बलः
verses.iast:
tān mṛtyu vaśam āpannān akampana vaśam gatān |
samīkṣya hanumān jnātīn upatasthe mahā balaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing those companions, getting under the sway of death pursued by Akampana's darts, the mighty Hanuman went to their rescue.

verses.devanagari:
तम् महा प्लवगम् दृष्ट्वा सर्वे प्लवग यूथपाः |
समेत्य समरे वीराह् सहिताह् पर्यवारयन्
verses.iast:
tam mahā plavagam dṛṣṭvā sarve plavaga yūthapāḥ |
sametya samare vīrāh sahitāh paryavārayan
verses.translation: Seeing Hanuman their great leader, all those valiant and the best of the monkeys together rallied and grouped themselves boldly round him.

verses.devanagari:
व्यवस्थितम् हनूमन्तम् ते दृष्ट्वा हरि यूथपाः |
बभूवुर् बलवन्तो हि बलवन्तम् उपाश्रिताः
verses.iast:
vyavasthitam hanūmantam te dṛṣṭvā hari yūthapāḥ |
babhūvur balavanto hi balavantam upāśritāḥ
verses.translation: Observing Hanuman's courage, those excellent monkeys took shelter in his powerfulness and became powerfulness and became powerful indeed.

verses.devanagari:
अकम्पनस् तु शैल आभम् हनूमन्तम् अवस्थितम् |
महा इन्द्र;इव धाराभिह् शरैर् अभिववर्ष ह
verses.iast:
akampanas tu śaila ābham hanūmantam avasthitam |
mahā indra;iva dhārābhih śarair abhivavarṣa ha
verses.translation: Akampana, like Mahendra the Lord of celestials, assailed a hail of arrows on Hanuman, who remained as firm as a rock.

verses.devanagari:
अचिन्तयित्वा बाण ओघान् शरीरे पतितान् शितान् |
अकम्पन वध अर्थाय मनो दध्रे महा बलः
verses.iast:
acintayitvā bāṇa oghān śarīre patitān śitān |
akampana vadha arthāya mano dadhre mahā balaḥ
verses.translation: Heedless of the flood of weapons that fell upon his body, the mighty Hanuman resolved in his mind to slay Akampana.

verses.devanagari:
स प्रहस्य महा तेजा हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः |
अभिदुद्राव तद् रक्षह् कम्पयन्न् इव मेदिनीम्
verses.iast:
sa prahasya mahā tejā hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ |
abhidudrāva tad rakṣah kampayann iva medinīm
verses.translation: Laughing heartily , that Hanuman, the son of Maruta the wind-god and possessing a great splendour, leapt on the demon, causing the earth to shake as it were.

glosses.meaning: and thes on of Maruta the wind-god

verses.devanagari:
तस्य अभिनर्दमानस्य दीप्यमानस्य तेजसा |
बभूव रूपम् दुर्धर्षम् दीप्तस्य इव विभावसोः
verses.iast:
tasya abhinardamānasya dīpyamānasya tejasā |
babhūva rūpam durdharṣam dīptasya iva vibhāvasoḥ
verses.translation: As he roared burning with energy, the form of Hanuman became difficult to overpower, like a blazing fire.

verses.devanagari:
आत्मानम् त्व् अप्रहरणम् ज्नात्वा क्रोध समन्वितः |
शैलम् उत्पाटयाम् आस वेगेन हरि पुम्गवः
verses.iast:
ātmānam tv apraharaṇam jnātvā krodha samanvitaḥ |
śailam utpāṭayām āsa vegena hari pumgavaḥ
verses.translation: Knowing himself to be bereft of any weapon, Hanuman the excellent monkey, with a rage, uplifted a mountain quickly.

glosses.meaning: to be bereft of any weapon

verses.devanagari:
तम् गृहीत्वा महा शैलम् पाणिना एकेन मारुतिः |
विनद्य सुमहा नादम् भ्रामयाम् आस वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
tam gṛhītvā mahā śailam pāṇinā ekena mārutiḥ |
vinadya sumahā nādam bhrāmayām āsa vīryavān
verses.translation: That valiant Hanuman, seizing a very great mountain with one hand and letting up a roar, began to spin it rapidly.

verses.devanagari:
ततस् तम् अभिदुद्राव राक्षस इन्द्रम् अकम्पनम् |
यथा हि नमुचिम् सम्ख्ये वज्रेण इव पुरम् दरः
verses.iast:
tatas tam abhidudrāva rākṣasa indram akampanam |
yathā hi namucim samkhye vajreṇa iva puram daraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, as formerly in an encounter Indra the Lord of celestials hurled his thunderbolt at Namuchi, Hanuman rushed towards Akampana.

verses.devanagari:
अकम्पनस् तु तद् दृष्ट्वा गिरि शृन्गम् समुद्यतम् |
दूराद् एव महा बाणैर् अर्ध चन्द्रैर् व्यदारयत्
verses.iast:
akampanas tu tad dṛṣṭvā giri śṛngam samudyatam |
dūrād eva mahā bāṇair ardha candrair vyadārayat
verses.translation: Beholding that crag flying towards him, Akampana shattered it even from a distance by means of his great crescent-shaped arrows.

glosses.meaning: each having the shape of a crescent.

verses.devanagari:
तत् पर्वत अग्रम् आकाशे रक्षो बाण विदारितम् |
विकीर्णम् पतितम् दृष्ट्वा हनूमान् क्रोध मूर्चितः
verses.iast:
tat parvata agram ākāśe rakṣo bāṇa vidāritam |
vikīrṇam patitam dṛṣṭvā hanūmān krodha mūrcitaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that rocky peak shatterd in the air by the demon's arrows and falling in pieces, Hanuman became mad with anger.

verses.devanagari:
सो अश्व कर्णम् समासाद्य रोष दर्प अन्वितो हरिः |
तूर्णम् उत्पाटयाम् आस महा गिरिम् इव उच्च्रितम्
verses.iast:
so aśva karṇam samāsādya roṣa darpa anvito hariḥ |
tūrṇam utpāṭayām āsa mahā girim iva uccritam
verses.translation: Approaching an Ashwakarna tree as large as a mountain, in the transport of rage that possessed him, that Hanuman uprooted it speedily.

glosses.meaning: in the transport of rage that possessed him

verses.devanagari:
तम् गृहीत्वा महा स्कन्धम् सो अश्व कर्णम् महा द्युतिः |
प्रगृह्य परया प्रीत्या भ्रामयामास भूतले
verses.iast:
tam gṛhītvā mahā skandham so aśva karṇam mahā dyutiḥ |
pragṛhya parayā prītyā bhrāmayāmāsa bhūtale
verses.translation: Taking hold of that Ashvakarna tree with large branches, in his great strength, Hanuman with immense delight spinned it, while standing on the ground.

verses.devanagari:
प्रधावन्न् उरु वेगेन प्रभन्जंस् तरसा द्रुमान् |
हनूमान् परम क्रुद्धश् चरणैर् दारयत् क्षितिम्
verses.iast:
pradhāvann uru vegena prabhanjaṃs tarasā drumān |
hanūmān parama kruddhaś caraṇair dārayat kṣitim
verses.translation: Then, the highly enraged Hanuman began to run with great strides, breaking down the trees by his strength and tearing up the earth with his feet.

verses.devanagari:
गजांसः च सगज आरोहान् सरथान् रथिनस् तथा |
जघान हनुमान् धीमान् राक्षसांश् च पदातिकान्
verses.iast:
gajāṃsḥ ca sagaja ārohān sarathān rathinas tathā |
jaghāna hanumān dhīmān rākṣasāṃś ca padātikān
verses.translation: Hanuman struck down elephants as also who rode upon them and charioteers with their chariots and the terrific infantry of demons.

glosses.meaning: as also who rode upon them

verses.devanagari:
तम् अन्तकम् इव क्रुद्धम् समरे प्राण हारिणम् |
हनूमन्तम् अभिप्रेक्ष्य राक्षसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः
verses.iast:
tam antakam iva kruddham samare prāṇa hāriṇam |
hanūmantam abhiprekṣya rākṣasā vipradudruvuḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that Hanuman, like unto Yama the Destroyer of vital Breaths, full of wrath armed with a tree and taking off lives, the demons took of flight.

glosses.meaning: like unto Yama the Destroyer of Vital breaths

verses.devanagari:
तम् आपतन्तम् सम्क्रुद्धम् राक्षसानाम् भय आवहम् |
ददर्श अकम्पनो वीरश् चुक्रोध च ननाद च
verses.iast:
tam āpatantam samkruddham rākṣasānām bhaya āvaham |
dadarśa akampano vīraś cukrodha ca nanāda ca
verses.translation: The valiant Akampana, beholding that Hanuman who was enraged and rushing on, sowing terror among his soldiers, was greatly perturbed and set up a mighty shout.

glosses.meaning: and set up a mighty shout.

verses.devanagari:
स चतुर्दशभिर् बाणैह् शितैर् देह विदारणैः |
निर्बिभेद हनूमन्तम् महा वीर्यम् अकम्पनः
verses.iast:
sa caturdaśabhir bāṇaih śitair deha vidāraṇaiḥ |
nirbibheda hanūmantam mahā vīryam akampanaḥ
verses.translation: With fourteen sharp arrows that tore the flesh, that Akampana pierced the highly valiant Hanuman.

verses.devanagari:
स तथा प्रतिविद्धस् तु बह्वीभिह् शर वृष्टिभिः |
हनूमान् ददृशे वीरह् प्ररूढ;इव सानुमान्
verses.iast:
sa tathā pratividdhas tu bahvībhih śara vṛṣṭibhiḥ |
hanūmān dadṛśe vīrah prarūḍha;iva sānumān
verses.translation: Riddled with sharp-pointed shafts, that warrior Hanuman appeared like a mountain on which a number of plants shooted up.

glosses.meaning: on which number of plants sprang up.

verses.devanagari:
विरराज महावीर्यो महाकायो महाबलः |
पुष्पिताशोकसम्काशो विधूम इव पावकः
verses.iast:
virarāja mahāvīryo mahākāyo mahābalaḥ |
puṣpitāśokasamkāśo vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: That mighty Hanuman of great strength with a large body shone like a fire without smoke and resembled a blooming Ashoka tree.

glosses.meaning: and resembling an Ashoka tree in flowering.

verses.devanagari:
ततो अन्यम् वृक्षम् उत्पाट्य कृत्वा वेगम् अनुत्तमम् |
शिरस्य् अभिजघान आशु राक्षस इन्द्रम् अकम्पनम्
verses.iast:
tato anyam vṛkṣam utpāṭya kṛtvā vegam anuttamam |
śirasy abhijaghāna āśu rākṣasa indram akampanam
verses.translation: Thereafter, showing a great haste in uprooting another tree, Hanuman struck the head of Akampana the General of demons.

verses.devanagari:
स वृक्षेण हतस् तेन सक्रोधेन महात्मना |
राक्षसो वानर इन्द्रेण पपात स ममार च
verses.iast:
sa vṛkṣeṇa hatas tena sakrodhena mahātmanā |
rākṣaso vānara indreṇa papāta sa mamāra ca
verses.translation: Struck with a tree by that high-souled and enraged Hanuman, that demon fell down and died.

verses.devanagari:
तम् दृष्ट्वा निहतम् भूमौ राक्षस इन्द्रम् अकम्पनम् |
व्यथिता राक्षसाह् सर्वे क्षिति कम्प;इव द्रुमाः
verses.iast:
tam dṛṣṭvā nihatam bhūmau rākṣasa indram akampanam |
vyathitā rākṣasāh sarve kṣiti kampa;iva drumāḥ
verses.translation: Seeing their leader Akampana lying lifeless on earth, all the demons trembled as the trees do during an earthquake.

verses.devanagari:
त्यक्त प्रहरणाह् सर्वे राक्षसास् ते पराजिताः |
लङ्काम् अभिययुस् त्रस्ता वानरैस् तैर् अभिद्रुताः
verses.iast:
tyakta praharaṇāh sarve rākṣasās te parājitāḥ |
laṇ^kām abhiyayus trastā vānarais tair abhidrutāḥ
verses.translation: All those defeated warriors, throwing their arms, escaped in the direction of Lanka, terrified, pursued by those monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
ते मुक्त केशाः सम्भ्रान्ता भग्न मानाह् पराजिताः |
स्रवत् श्रम जलैर् अन्गैह् श्वसन्तो विप्रदुद्रुवुः
verses.iast:
te mukta keśāḥ sambhrāntā bhagna mānāh parājitāḥ |
sravat śrama jalair angaih śvasanto vipradudruvuḥ
verses.translation: Their hair loosened, bewildered, their pride broken by defeat, their limbs dripping with sweat, those demons fled, blowing out their breaths.

verses.devanagari:
अन्योन्यम् प्रममन्तुस् ते विविशुर् नगरम् भयात् |
पृष्ठतस् ते सुसम्मूढाह् प्रेक्षमाणा मुहुर् मुहुः
verses.iast:
anyonyam pramamantus te viviśur nagaram bhayāt |
pṛṣṭhatas te susammūḍhāh prekṣamāṇā muhur muhuḥ
verses.translation: Mad with fear, looking back again and again and crushing each other in haste, they entered the city.

verses.devanagari:
तेषु लन्काम् प्रविष्टेषु राक्षसेषु महा बलाः |
समेत्य हरयह् सर्वे हनूमन्तम् अपूजयन्
verses.iast:
teṣu lankām praviṣṭeṣu rākṣaseṣu mahā balāḥ |
sametya harayah sarve hanūmantam apūjayan
verses.translation: When those demons had entered Lanka, all the mighty monkeys approached Hanuman and paid homage to him.

verses.devanagari:
सो अपि प्रहृष्टस् तान् सर्वान् हरीन् सम्प्रत्यपूजयत् |
हनूमान् सत्त्व सम्पन्नो यथा अर्हम् अनुकूलतः
verses.iast:
so api prahṛṣṭas tān sarvān harīn sampratyapūjayat |
hanūmān sattva sampanno yathā arham anukūlataḥ
verses.translation: That Hanuman, of noble nature honoured all those delighted monkeys, in accord with their rank and the occasion.

verses.devanagari:
विनेदुसः च यथा प्राणम् हरयो जित काशिनः |
चकर्षुसः च पुनस् तत्र सप्राणान् एव राक्षसान्
verses.iast:
vinedusḥ ca yathā prāṇam harayo jita kāśinaḥ |
cakarṣusḥ ca punas tatra saprāṇān eva rākṣasān
verses.translation: The triumphant monkeys shouted in accord with their nighty and once again dragged the demons who were still alive there on the battle-field.

verses.devanagari:
स वीर शोभाम् अभजन् महा कपिः |
समेत्य रक्षांसि निहत्य मारुतिः |
महा असुरम् भीमम् अमित्र नाशनम् |
यथैव विष्णुर् बलिनम् चमू मुखे
verses.iast:
sa vīra śobhām abhajan mahā kapiḥ |
sametya rakṣāṃsi nihatya mārutiḥ |
mahā asuram bhīmam amitra nāśanam |
yathaiva viṣṇur balinam camū mukhe
verses.translation: That great monkey, born of Maruta having encountered and killed the demons, enjoyed the same renown as Vishnu when he overcame the mighty and terrific demon of immense power destroying his enemies in the forefront of the battle.

glosses.meaning: in the forefront of the battle.

verses.devanagari:
अपूजयन् देव गणास् तदा कपिम् |
स्वयम् च रामो अतिबलश् च लक्ष्मणह् |
तथैव सुग्रीव मुखाह् प्लवम् गमा |
विभीषणश् चैव महा बलस् तदा
verses.iast:
apūjayan deva gaṇās tadā kapim |
svayam ca rāmo atibalaś ca lakṣmaṇah |
tathaiva sugrīva mukhāh plavam gamā |
vibhīṣaṇaś caiva mahā balas tadā
verses.translation: Then, the troops of deities along with Rama himself, the exceedingly strong Lakshmana, Sugreeva and other monkeys and the mighty Vibhishana paid homage to Hanuman.
